_comment: wp-portfolio-sync tuning values. Every key follows R0/R4: no numeric literal lives in the scripts themselves, and every value here carries its own provenance.

timeout_s.provenance: chosen by the operator on 2026-10-01 (same value as form-service)

get_retries.provenance: chosen by the operator on 2026-10-01; PUT is never retried by design

retry_backoff_s.provenance: chosen by the operator on 2026-10-06 (PR #50 review, L2): a pause between GET retries so a 429 (rate limited) or a 5xx is not hammered immediately

per_page.provenance: specified: maximum per_page accepted by the WordPress REST API
